description: Defines a class for interacting with UI elements in the Scientific mode of a calculator application, including buttons for trigonometric functions, angle units, and other scientific operations.

classes.name: ScientificOperatorsPanel
classes.description: Encapsulates UI elements and interactions for the scientific operators panel in the calculator app.

classes.name: AngleOperatorState
classes.description: Enumeration for angle measurement units: Degrees, Radians, Gradians.

classes.name: FEButtonState
classes.description: Enumeration for Fixed to Exponential button states: Normal, Exponential.

methods.name: GetAngleOperatorButton
methods.description: Determines which angle unit button (deg, rad, grad) is present based on page source.

methods.name: SetAngleOperator
methods.description: Sets the angle measurement unit by clicking the appropriate button.

methods.name: ResetFEButton
methods.description: Resets the Fixed to Exponential button to its default state.

methods.name: ResetTrigDropdownToggles
methods.description: Resets trig function dropdown toggles to default state.
